grade_reason: Eight web searches found no statement by Oliver Gilbert III about AI, AI risk or AI policy since 1 January 2025.
notes: All 8 searches ran; none was refused. Results about AI named other people (Laura Gilbert, Oliver Sourbut, Oliver Ilott and others), not this Miami-Dade commissioner. Coverage of his campaign (Tampa Bay Times, political.org, BallotReady, FEC) covers affordability, healthcare, childcare, immigration, housing, transit and a pro-cryptocurrency group's attack ads, but nothing on AI. His campaign site was not found in results; oliverforcongress.com pages belong to a different candidate (Oliver Larkin, FL-25), so I did not use them. No Miami-Dade County Commission remarks on AI were found. No source shows him sponsoring the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (he was not a House member). No pages were opened because nothing relevant was found to open. Absence of results does not prove he has never spoken about AI, for example in commission meetings or local interviews not indexed by search.
